content: Yesuꞌa ago he tiꞌniya gemae
Satepiꞌmo hogote afinaꞌmo kotilamiyapiꞌmo aꞌne anagaꞌmogi alagepa atumo neꞌaiya malasinimo alo huꞌnaya malasinimo alini uꞌa
agayana ani yafaꞌmo ago alino heleve huno ataleꞌnigeno yafa kaꞌmo aka huꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌa
uꞌa yafakapiꞌmo haiꞌa agayana kefaꞌamo ohaneꞌnigeꞌa ageꞌnae.
Na kava huꞌnifi, huteꞌa apakesa alaꞌamo neꞌafigeꞌanaeꞌmo alave alave nehiya kukenamo vailifa vekalaꞌmo hapaopaleꞌmo afole aiteꞌana he tiꞌana maiꞌnaꞌageꞌapaeꞌmo
koli huteꞌa ape huꞌa maiꞌnageꞌanaeꞌmo, na kava higetapa afaꞌa maiꞌniya vekamo kanoluleꞌmo etapa kahauya nehae.
Manifiꞌmo oꞌmaiꞌnifa ago he tino uꞌniye. Galeliya kotegamo maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo ago lapa painoꞌaeꞌmo,

Vemo Mafaꞌnemo avaleli uꞌa hosu vayaꞌai apayapiꞌmo atesageꞌapaeꞌmo malipu yosaleꞌmo nili aiteꞌa aliꞌa he tiꞌa atesageno faliteno loleꞌe magoꞌe afinaꞌmo kanolufiꞌmo maiteno ago he tigiye, huno huꞌniya geeꞌmo lapakesa afitapa ho hiyo, huꞌana hapa paiꞌnaꞌageꞌapaeꞌmo
apakesa afiꞌa ho huꞌnae.
Yafa kaꞌmo atale uꞌa leveniꞌa vayaꞌe muki vayaꞌefeꞌmo ani kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌa hapa paiꞌnae.
Maliyaꞌa Maganala kotega anagi Yovanaꞌagi Maliya Yemisi itaꞌamoꞌagi magoꞌe aꞌne anaganagi huꞌa ani gemo apa vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa paiꞌnageꞌa
afiteꞌapaeꞌmo afaꞌa aigofe nehae, huꞌa apakesa afiꞌnae.

Apakesa afiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa Pitaꞌa nagu nagu huno uno yafa kapiꞌmo ape huno ageyana hayaeno ateꞌniya lavolavoꞌageꞌmo haneꞌnigeno ageteno ataleno neꞌenoꞌaeꞌmo, haiya agufa kavaꞌmo huꞌnifi, huno agesa afime afime noꞌalega uꞌniye.
Lole vekalaꞌmo Emeyasi kotega neꞌvaya kateꞌmo neꞌvaꞌagenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa afole aiꞌniya gemae
Ani afinaꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiꞌa vekalaꞌmo Emeyasi taonifiꞌmo ugefeꞌmo uꞌnaꞌae. Yulusalemu taonifatiꞌmo Emeyasi taonimo neꞌvaya kaꞌmo aise afagiꞌaleꞌmo ina kavaꞌmo huno leveni kilomitamo haneꞌniye.
Anakaemo neꞌuꞌanaeꞌmo afole aiꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ge huge afige hume hume neꞌvaꞌageno
Yesuꞌa agaiꞌageꞌmo eno anakame huno anakaeꞌeꞌmo uꞌniye.
Anaulagaleꞌmo mago yaꞌmoꞌa ago aino ati kaeꞌnigeꞌana Yesuꞌmae, huꞌana oꞌageꞌnaꞌae.
Yesuꞌa, na agufa kavafeꞌmo ge huge afige hume hume neꞌvaꞌae, huno anafi geꞌnigeꞌanaeꞌmo anileꞌmo he tiꞌana maiꞌneꞌanaeꞌmo anaipamoꞌmo kana huge hosu anaugosamo kalige huꞌnaꞌae.

Ani vekalapatiꞌmo mago vekamo agiꞌamo Kiliyopasiꞌa geꞌaleꞌmo aeno atagaina huno ha painoꞌaeꞌmo, muki vayaꞌmo Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo ete ete huꞌa maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi hemenimo afole aiꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌa neꞌafiyaꞌmonanafa kagaemo oꞌafika maiꞌnapiye, huno afi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo,

na agufa kavaꞌmo afole aiꞌniye, huno anafi geꞌnigeꞌanaeꞌmo, Yesuꞌa Nasalasa vekamo Gotitegati gemo alinino eno aeno hakalo huno hapa nepaiya vekamo maiꞌneno Goti aulagaleꞌe muki vayaꞌai apaulagaleꞌeꞌmo himamuꞌaletiꞌmo lokiya kavaꞌmo huge lokiya gemo hapa paige huno maiꞌniye.

Maiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌe yagaiꞌa nelataya vayaꞌmogiꞌeꞌmo kamiti amagisayafeꞌmo gamani vayaꞌaitegamo avaleli uꞌa ateteꞌa malipu yosaleꞌmo nili aiteꞌa aliꞌa he tiꞌa ateꞌnae.
Lagaemo, ani vekamoꞌa Isaleli vayaꞌmogita hatu maeno lategaiye, huta lagesa afitetaeꞌmo laipafatiꞌmo lamogaga aiꞌniye. Ani kavaꞌmo ago afole aiꞌnigeno loleꞌe magoꞌe afinaꞌmo ago uꞌniye.
Mago lagaeꞌeꞌmo maiꞌnaya aꞌnemogimo mago gemo laha paiꞌnagetaeꞌmo lahau aiꞌnone.

Apakaemo kotilamiyapiꞌmo yafakapiꞌmo uꞌa agayana kefaꞌamo ohaneꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo ataleꞌa aiꞌa atagi neꞌeꞌapaeꞌmo, enisole vekalaꞌmo anakeꞌnonageꞌanaeꞌmo, kanolufatiꞌmo ago he tino afaꞌa maiꞌniye, huꞌana laha paiꞌnaꞌae, huꞌa laha paiꞌnae.
Lagaepatiꞌmo mago lole vekalaꞌmo uꞌana aꞌne anagaꞌmogi laha paiꞌnaya kavafeꞌmo yafakapiꞌmo ageꞌnaꞌana Yesu kefaꞌamo oꞌageꞌnaꞌae, huꞌana ha paiꞌnaꞌagenoꞌaeꞌmo,

O negi vekalane, huꞌna, lanakaemo muki geꞌamo Gotitegati gemo alini eꞌa aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa paiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi huꞌnaya geeꞌmo lanakesa afitana fatago hisaꞌafeꞌmo ago lanake kaniꞌnigetana vase vase hutana neꞌafiꞌae.
Apakaemo, Kalaisi vekamo hogoteno agafu kitesigenoꞌaekeꞌmo ala agiꞌamo aligiye, huꞌa avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya gemo oꞌafiꞌnaꞌafiye.

Agaemo Moseseꞌa agaefeꞌmo ava gemo huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya gemo aepa faiteno aepaꞌamo alino anaya maleꞌniye. Ani kavaꞌmo huno muki vayaꞌmo Gotitegati gemo alini eꞌa aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa nepaiya vayaꞌmogimo agaefeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌnaya gemo aepaꞌamo alino anaya maleme maleme uꞌniye.
Anakaemo utaꞌa maiguꞌae, huꞌana huꞌnaꞌa taonimo haopaleꞌmo uꞌa avaꞌyi huteꞌapaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa ago anataleno uno afagi hugekana huꞌnigeꞌanaeꞌmo
lokiya gefatiꞌmo huꞌanaeꞌmo, hemenimo ago unetiꞌnigeno hani hugefe hiyanagi ataleka eka laꞌagaeꞌeꞌmo maiyo, huꞌana ha paiꞌnaꞌageno eno nopiꞌmo haino anakaeꞌeꞌmo lokaeno maiꞌniye.
Hiꞌyalamuteꞌmo anakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeno maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo peleti mayamo alino nunumuꞌmo huno hao ke heteno akaya heno anamiꞌniye.
Anamiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo anaulagamo ayakeꞌnigeꞌana Yesuꞌmae, huꞌana agetaꞌageno malage huno alino lageso huꞌnigeꞌana magoꞌe huꞌana oꞌageꞌnaꞌae.
Anakaiꞌanimo, kategamo neꞌetaeꞌmo Goti Mukufati gemo aepaꞌamo alino laꞌaya neꞌmalegenoꞌaeꞌmo laꞌaipafiꞌmo hagaꞌage gemo afole aiꞌnigeno laꞌaipamoꞌmo falu huteno laꞌamogaga aiꞌniye, huꞌana huꞌnaꞌae.

Huteꞌanaeꞌmo malage huꞌana he tiꞌana Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo aiꞌana atagi neꞌana eꞌnaꞌae. Eꞌana avaꞌyi huteꞌana apakeꞌnaꞌana leveniꞌa vayaꞌe mago apakaeꞌeꞌmo lokaeꞌa maiꞌnaya vayaꞌeꞌmo aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo
apakaemo, alagi lama ge huꞌa Ala kava neꞌmo ago he tiꞌniye. He titenoꞌaeꞌmo Saimonitegamo ago afole aiꞌnigeno ageꞌniye, huꞌa hana paiꞌnageꞌanaeꞌmo
kategamo afole aiꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huge peleti mayamo alino akaya heꞌnigeꞌana Yesuꞌmae, huꞌana ageꞌnaꞌa kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huge huꞌana hapa paiꞌnaꞌae.
Yesuꞌa geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌai folagaꞌapifiꞌmo afole aiꞌnigeꞌa ageꞌnaya gemae
Ani gemo hapa nepaiꞌagenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa agaiꞌageꞌmo folagaꞌapifatiꞌmo afole aitenoꞌaeꞌmo, lapaipamoꞌmo falu hino, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,
afene, huꞌa huteꞌa hapau aiteꞌa atete huꞌnae.
Agaemo, na kava higetapaeꞌmo lapaipamoꞌmo kana huꞌnigetapa lole lapakesa neꞌafiye.

Nayapiꞌe naiyafiꞌeꞌmo eta agetetapa name alitetapaeꞌmo, agaemae, hutapa nageyo. Amega nagufaꞌe nayamufaꞌniꞌeꞌmo haneꞌniyana afeꞌmoꞌa amega agufaꞌe ayamufaꞌeꞌmo ani kava huno ohaneꞌniye, huno hapa paiteno
ayaꞌe aiyaꞌeꞌmo alino apave liꞌnigeꞌa
ageteꞌapaeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌa apamogaga aiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa apakesa afiꞌa fatago osuꞌnafa lole apakesa afiꞌnae. Agaemo, mago neꞌyaꞌmo manile haneꞌnifiye, huno apafi geꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo
mago kae malefa noyameꞌe kevekeve anuꞌeꞌmo aliꞌa amiꞌnageno
apaulagaleꞌmo alino neꞌniye.

Netenoꞌaeꞌmo, mani kavafeꞌmo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo ago lapa paiꞌnaeꞌmo, muki kavafeꞌmo nava gemo huꞌa avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya gemo afole aigiye. Moseseꞌa avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya nava gegi Gotitegati gemo alini eꞌa aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa nepaiya vayaꞌmogi avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya nava gegi Samu gefiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya nava gemogi huno afole aigiye,
huno apakesa huno halo aino hapa paiteno alino apaya maleꞌniye.
Huno hapa paitenoꞌaeꞌmo, Kalaisi vekamo agafu kisigeno falitenoꞌaeꞌmo napa tali afinaꞌmo kanolufatiꞌmo he tigiye.

He tino maiꞌnisigeꞌapaeꞌmo Yulusalemu taonifatiꞌmo aepa faiteꞌa hapa paiꞌapaeꞌmo, lapaipamo alita afe legenoꞌao Gotiꞌa Kalaisi agiꞌaletiꞌmo hosu kavatapimo alino ataleno, huꞌa hapa paiteꞌapaeꞌmo ani agufa gemo huꞌa muki nofi vayaꞌaifeꞌmo aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa paisaya kavaꞌmo haneꞌniye, huꞌa avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnae.
Lapakaemo mani kavaꞌmo ago ageꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo ani kavafeꞌmo faigoko geꞌnimo hutapa hapa paisaya vayaꞌmo maiꞌnae.

Afiyo, Afoꞌnimoꞌmo, Nauneꞌnameꞌmo aliꞌna lapamiguve, huno lapa paiꞌniyanageꞌna Goti Aunemeꞌamo aliꞌna atesugeno lapakaetegamo emiꞌnegaiye. Emiꞌnegaiyaꞌmonanafa utapa Yulusalemu taonifikeꞌmo hogotetapa agava maime maime neꞌvigenoꞌao Goti Aunemeꞌamoꞌmo emineno lokiya vaino lapategaiye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Gotiꞌa Yesuꞌmo halate kokuꞌnapiꞌmo avalelino haiꞌniya gemae
Agaemo apavalelino Metani taoni haopalegamo uno avaꞌyi huteno ayaꞌmo alino asagauno aeno hayo huꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa alagepa huno lapa maeno,
huno hapa nepaigenoꞌaeꞌmo Gotiꞌa kokuꞌnapiꞌmo avalelino haiꞌniye.
Nehaigeꞌapaeꞌmo agaefeꞌmo mono huteꞌa aiꞌa atagi neꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo neꞌuꞌapaeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌa apamogaga aime aime uꞌnae.
Maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo muki afinaꞌmo alopa mono nopiꞌmo haiꞌa Goti agiꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga huꞌa atege atege huꞌa maiꞌnae. He, lama ge.
